title: AIP Morning Brief — Trailer: meet Maya and Jordan!
show_notes: **Trailer.** What The AIP Morning Brief covers: client capex signals, competitors, macro and SaaS benchmarks, scored by confidence with base, best and worst cases — and three things to raise with the CFO every morning. Hosted by Maya and Jordan.

dialogue.speaker: ANCHOR
dialogue.text: Morning! Welcome to The AIP Morning Brief. I'm Maya.

dialogue.speaker: STRATEGIST
dialogue.text: And I'm Jordan. Grab a coffee, because there is a lot going on in infrastructure right now.

dialogue.speaker: ANCHOR
dialogue.text: Honestly, there's never a quiet week! So here's the deal. Every morning, in about ten minutes, we cover the news that moves asset investment planning. Utility rate cases, regulators, grid and water spending, competitors...

dialogue.speaker: STRATEGIST
dialogue.text: ...and the money side. Interest rates, SaaS valuations, the numbers that actually matter.

dialogue.speaker: ANCHOR
dialogue.text: Right. And Jordan doesn't just read the headlines.

dialogue.speaker: STRATEGIST
dialogue.text: No chance. I tell you what I think. Every story gets a confidence rating, and if it's a big one, you get the best case, the worst case, and where I think it really lands.

dialogue.speaker: ANCHOR
dialogue.text: Opinionated, but only when the evidence earns it.

dialogue.speaker: STRATEGIST
dialogue.text: Exactly. And we finish every single episode with three things worth raising with your CFO that day.

dialogue.speaker: ANCHOR
dialogue.text: Short, sharp, and hopefully a bit of fun. See you tomorrow at six!
